entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1222932018450870144: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: distance 52.138 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.014), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 52.138 +/- 0.73 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 19.4965 +/- 0.0850 mas (same row, RUWE 2.05), 229.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -78.907, -64.894 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 7.167 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: radius 7.167 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 36.192 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.049) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5292 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: effective temperature 5292 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 1222932018450870144, cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 731: HR 5889; VizieR III/202 (6 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffefe3. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 141714 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 5889 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 5889 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 5889 is not in part2; gaia-xp: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,292 K and log g 3.29 (u1 0.555, u2 0.199): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 3.29 from 2025A&A...698A..93J; the 15 published values span log g 2.9134 to 3.422, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
